[[File:Swordfish detail.png|left|180px]]
'''Swordfish''' is a type of [[fish]] that restores 14 [[Hitpoints]] when eaten. It can be obtained by cooking [[raw swordfish]] on a [[fire]] or [[cooking range]], requiring level 45 [[Cooking]] and granting 140 [[experience]] when successful. When cooking there is a chance to fail, resulting in a [[burnt swordfish]]. The [[burn rate]] decreases as the player's Cooking level increases, and it will stop burning entirely at Cooking level 80 on ranges and level 86 on fires.

Swordfish are one of the fish required by [[Caleb]] during the quest [[Family Crest]].

When eaten, the message {{Mes|You eat the swordfish.}} is displayed. 

Swordfish are the best single-serving food in free-to-play worlds with 2 more hitpoints than [[Lobster|lobsters]]. It is the fastest way to gain health in free-to-play worlds if eaten with an [[anchovy pizza]] in one [[tick]].
